# VEGA Mexican Cuisine

> VEGA Mexican Cuisine, located at 189 E Hartsdale Ave in Hartsdale, NY, offers a modern take on traditional Mexican dishes with options for various dietary needs. The restaurant features a variety of tacos, enchiladas, fajitas, and fresh guacamole.

## Menu
VEGA Mexican Cuisine offers a modern take on traditional Mexican dishes, featuring a variety of tacos, enchiladas, fajitas, and fresh guacamole, with options for various dietary needs.
